## Generated Files and Build Artifacts

### Files Generated by Build Scripts

Edit sources, not generated output. Stage only sources.

| Source | Generator | Ignored output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data/html/` | `scripts/build_html.py`, run by the PlatformIO pre-build | `src/network/html/*.generated.h` |
| `lib/I18n/translations/*.yaml` | `scripts/gen_i18n.py` | `lib/I18n/I18nKeys.h`, `I18nStrings.h`, `I18nStrings.cpp` |

Other ignored artifacts include `.pio/`, `build/`, and `compile_commands.json`.

### Modifying Generated Content Workflow

For HTML, edit `data/html/`; the next relevant firmware build regenerates the
headers. For i18n, follow the translation workflow below. Generated outputs
remain unstaged even when used for local verification.

### Translation workflow

Every user-facing string uses `tr(STR_*)`; log messages may stay hardcoded.
Add new keys to `english.yaml`, then regenerate:

```bash
python3 scripts/gen_i18n.py lib/I18n/translations lib/I18n/
```

English is the reference/fallback; other translations are not required for handoff.
Language files require `_language_name`, `_language_code`, `_order`, `_bcp47`,
and string keys. `_bcp47` orders language enums/menus: English first, then tags
alphabetically. `_order` is still required and unique, but does not order the menu.
Saved preferences use `_language_code`, not enum ordinals.

`custom_i18n_builtin_langs` / `--builtin-langs` may filter built-ins; English
remains included. Consult [i18n.md](../../docs/i18n.md) for metadata/build semantics.

### Font generation

Built-in source fonts live in ignored `lib/EpdFont/fontsrc/`; conversion is
documented in `lib/EpdFont/README`. Update the built-in definition, registration
in `src/main.cpp`, and `src/fontIds.h` when adding one.

SD fonts use [sd-card-fonts.md](../../docs/sd-card-fonts.md). Catalog
`scriptGroups` and family `scripts` belong in `lib/EpdFont/scripts/sd-fonts.yaml`;
conversion `intervals` describe glyph coverage, not browser grouping. Generate
the manifest with `scripts/generate-font-manifest.py`; check
`lib/EpdFont/scripts/cpfont_version.py` before changing binary/manifest contracts.
Metadata-only changes preserve font bytes:
release conversion downloads source fonts, so verify asset hashes before publishing.

## Cache Management and Invalidation

### Cache Structure on SD Card

Book data uses `/.crosspoint/epub_<hash>/{book.bin,progress.bin,cover.bmp,sections/*.bin}`.
The directory key is `std::hash<std::string>{}(filepath)`, not content identity.
Rename/move flows must preserve progress and other book state; replacing contents
at the same path leaves this key unchanged.

### Cache Invalidation Rules

Inspect `Section::loadSectionFile()` for the full comparison of layout settings,
fonts, and viewport dimensions. Format/version mismatches invalidate saved data.
Path changes select another cache; same-path content replacement needs the
appropriate freshness check and an affected-cache reset during testing.

Back up progress/state first. Prefer clearing only the affected book's
`sections/` when checking layout regeneration. Removing all of `.crosspoint/`
also deletes settings, credentials, and application state.

### Cache File Format Versioning

Read `BOOK_CACHE_VERSION` and `SECTION_FILE_VERSION` from
`BookMetadataCache.cpp` and `Section.cpp`; layouts/history are in
[file-formats.md](../../docs/file-formats.md).
Increment the relevant version before changing serialized structure or layout
behavior that changes cached line breaks, widths, or word positions, and document
the new format there.

The partial-build version derives from the final version. Preserve that relation,
the incomplete-write sentinel, and suspended-build page/resume data. Verify both
completed and partial caches after a format change.

### Other persistent contracts

- TXT/Markdown use `lib/Txt/TxtToHtml` and the EPUB layout/reader pipeline.
  Include them in parser, layout, progress, and cache verification.
- `/.crosspoint/library.idx` has independent format/fold versions, freshness,
  and rebuild rules: see the CLX1 section of [file-formats.md](../../docs/file-formats.md)
  and `lib/LibraryIndex/`.
- Plugin manifests, outboxes, metadata sidecars, and per-book keys follow
  [sd-plugins.md](../../docs/sd-plugins.md) and
  [plugin-events.md](../../docs/plugin-events.md). Preserve isolation and
  existing rename/state handling.
